gaze.rule: art/briefs/title-screen.md, The gaze: every sightline ends on the god's head or upper body

notes: Revision 6 (Leon, 9 Nov 2026): the gaze-corrected render (every head thrown back, looking up and left at 45-60 degrees). The 16:9 frame is scaled to half the safe rect about its bottom-right corner, the placement that best aims the five sightlines at the god's face while keeping the squad on screen (errors 6-23 degrees; every line crosses the god's head or upper body). The rock is mirrored into the right and bottom overscan; near-opaque alpha (245-254) is made opaque. Uniform resize, no sharpening.
